interface.longDescription: Manage and query Calibre libraries with the calibredb CLI (local paths or Calibre Content server URLs). Use when listing books, searching/filtering library records, reading/updating metadata, adding/removing formats, exporting books, maintaining custom columns, running library checks, managing FTS indexing/search, or creating catalogs/backups from a Calibre library. Packaged as a marketplace skill for Codex and Claude Code. Category: Knowledge Management.
defaultPrompt: Use the CalibreDB skill when working on calibredb tasks.
